conventions.listNames: No spaces or underscores in list names: the REST entity type of a list with an underscore is encoded as _x005f_ and breaks hand-written flow calls.
conventions.internalNames: PascalCase, <= 32 chars, never start with an underscore, never reuse SharePoint reserved names (ID, Title, Created, Modified, Author, Editor, Version, Type, Status). Created via SchemaXml so internal name == Name below.
conventions.title: Every list keeps the built-in Title column but it is made non-required and holds a human-readable label written by flows (for example 'K100593 @ 1-A'). No logic reads Title.
conventions.stockKey: StockKey = UPPER(TRIM(ItemID)) + '|' + UPPER(TRIM(LocationCode)). '|' is forbidden inside ItemID and LocationCode.
conventions.ledgerKey: LedgerKey = StockKey + '#' + SeqNo for live rows; 'LEGACY|<sheet>|r<row>' for legacy rows.
conventions.timestamps: All DateTime columns store UTC. *Local text columns store America/Chicago text for display so every device shows the same time.
conventions.indexLimit: SharePoint Online allows 20 indexed columns per list; the largest list here uses 10.

lists.name: POUSettings
lists.description: Central configuration. One row per setting. Read by app and flows; edited only by POU Admins.

fields.name: SettingKey
fields.description: Stable key used by the app and flows.

fields.name: SettingValue
fields.description: Value as text. Must not contain double quotes or backslashes (flows build a JSON object from these rows).

fields.name: ValueType
fields.description: Documentation and validation hint.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: What the setting does.

lists.name: POUStations
lists.description: Cabinet stations. StationID is passed to the app in the launch URL (?StationID=CAB-01). Editable by Admins without touching the app.

fields.name: ExpectedAccountUPN
fields.description: Optional. If set, requests from this station must be authored by this Microsoft account.

lists.name: POULocations
lists.description: Known stocking locations (bin / shelf codes). New stock locations must reference an active row here.

lists.name: POUEmployees
lists.description: Badge holders. BadgeID is identification only. Role/MicrosoftUPN decide who may approve (via their own Microsoft sign-in), never the badge.

fields.name: BadgeID
fields.description: TEXT. Leading zeros preserved.

fields.name: MicrosoftUPN
fields.description: Entra sign-in name. Required for Supervisor/Admin approval authority. Matched case-insensitively against the authenticated author of a request.

lists.name: POUSessions
lists.description: Badge sessions created by the POU-Session flow. Never readable by operators.
lists.growth: hundreds per month (purged by weekly health flow)

fields.name: AppAccountUPN
fields.description: Microsoft account that was running the app. Requests in this session must be authored by it.

lists.name: POUItems
lists.description: Item master: one row per ItemID (part), regardless of how many locations stock it.

fields.name: ItemID
fields.description: TEXT. Upper-case, trimmed. Never numeric.

fields.name: LegacySourceRows
fields.description: Provenance: Inventory sheet rows this item was built from.

lists.name: POUStockLocations
lists.description: Item/location stock record: one row per ItemID at one LocationCode. OnHandQty is written ONLY by POU-ProcessRequest / POU-Sweeper.

fields.name: ItemName
fields.description: Denormalised copy of POUItems.ItemName for list display; repaired weekly.

fields.name: OnHandQty
fields.description: BLANK means no verified balance. Never 0 by default.

fields.name: StockVersion
fields.description: Equals the SeqNo of the last applied ledger row for this StockKey.

fields.name: LowStockFlag
fields.description: Stored (not calculated) so Power Apps can filter on it with delegation. Recomputed by posting and nightly.

lists.name: POURequests
lists.description: Request queue. Operators and supervisors can only ADD rows. A request is an instruction, not a completed movement.

fields.name: RequestID
fields.description: Client-generated GUID kept across retries. Duplicate-request protection.

fields.name: IsOpen
fields.description: Yes until a flow marks the request terminal. Lets the app list unresolved requests with one delegable filter.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: ISSUE/RECEIPT: units. AUDIT/OPENING: counted/opening quantity. ADJUSTMENT: new absolute quantity.

fields.name: ExpectedVersion
fields.description: StockVersion the client saw when the count began (AUDIT stale detection).

fields.name: PayloadJson
fields.description: ITEM_CREATE / LOCATION_ADD / PARAM_UPDATE fields as JSON.

fields.name: TargetRequestID
fields.description: APPROVE: request being approved or rejected.

fields.name: ClientLocalTime
fields.description: Informational device time text. Never used for ordering.

fields.name: InventoryEffect
fields.description: NotApplied is written only when no ledger intent exists (established, not assumed).

lists.name: POULedger
lists.description: Append-only movement ledger. Written only by flows. PostingState: Intent (written before stock changes) -> Posted. Voided rows never changed stock.
lists.growth: thousands per year; the largest list

fields.name: LedgerKey
fields.description: StockKey#SeqNo. The unique constraint is the compare-and-swap that serialises writers per stock record.

fields.name: RequestID
fields.description: Unique: one ledger row per request, ever (duplicate-posting protection).

fields.name: AffectsBalance
fields.description: No for legacy rows: they are history only and never replayed against stock.

fields.name: StockKey
fields.description: Blank for legacy rows whose location cannot be established.

fields.name: QtyDelta
fields.description: Signed. Blank when unknown (opening, first count, legacy without data).

fields.name: LegacyUser
fields.description: Name text exactly as recorded in the workbook. Never mapped to a badge.

fields.name: LegacyTimestampText
fields.description: Original workbook timestamp, unmodified.

fields.name: LocationResolution
fields.description: How StockKey was established for legacy rows.

lists.name: POUOpsEvents
lists.description: Operational findings raised by monitoring flows (stuck requests, drift, data-health). De-duplicates alert emails.
